title: Frequently Asked Questions, Google UCP Guide
notes: Read 2026-10-20 (page last updated 2026-10-16) and again 2026-11-14 through the .md twin (last updated 2026-11-03 UTC; the 2026-10-30 version differed only by an MCP question). Still says: merchant is MoR, PSP must process Google tokens, PAN_ONLY, Google-UCP-Prober/1.0 health checks, order data retained until the user requests deletion. Changed between 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-30: checkout requests carry UCP-Agent and a User-Agent of Google-Shopping-Merchant-Integration, Google/UCP* or Google-UCP-Prober/1.0; discovery and OAuth client_credentials requests carry no UCP-Agent; Account Linking uses OpenAuth or Google-AccountLinking-Fetcher/1.0; headers alone must not authenticate. Verification methods are now mutual TLS against Google's UCP Root CAs, ES256 RFC 9421 signatures checked against the keys at https://ucp.goog/.well-known/ucp.json (24-hour cache, refetch on an unknown kid) and source-ASN rules (AS15169; AS396982 for Account Linking). The earlier wording (the User-Agent begins with Google/UCP; verify by reverse DNS or published IP range files) has been replaced.

title: Network and WAF configuration, Google UCP Guide
notes: Read through the .md twin on 2026-11-14 (2026-11-15T03:01Z UTC). Outbound User-Agent Google-Shopping-Merchant-Integration (default outbound client) or Google/UCP* (sent when origin user-agent propagation is enabled); UCP-Agent on checkout, cart and order calls, for example profile="https://ucp.goog/profiles/2026-04-08/ucp.json"; POST and PUT requests also carry Request-Id, Idempotency-Key, Payment-Environment (live or sandbox) and X-Forwarded-For when a shopper IP is present; source ASN AS15169, whose ranges Google publishes in https://www.gstatic.com/ipranges/goog.json. Google does not guarantee static egress IP ranges and says not to use its crawler or fetcher IP files (googlebot.json and similar) for UCP allowlists.

title: A new way to shop: Introducing a more intuitive, agentic shopping experience for consumers and retailers in Canada
notes: datePublished 2026-11-04T11:00Z. Direct checkout powered by UCP is rolling out from that day to Canadian shoppers on AI Mode in Google Search and the Gemini app, from eligible retailers including lululemon, select Shopify merchants, Shoppers Drug Mart and Simons, with Google Pay using payment and shipping details saved in Google Wallet; retailers remain the seller of record; simplified UCP integration in Merchant Center starts next year and loyalty rewards come in the coming months.
